mapper.select: select user_num, user_name , user_id, user_pw , u.department_id, department_name , g.grade_id, grade_name from user u left join department d on u.department_id = d.department_id left join grade g on u.grade_id = g.grade_id where user_num=#{userNum}
mapper.insert: insert into user (user_num, user_name, user_id, user_pw, department_id, grade_id) values(#{userNum}, #{userName}, #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{departmentId}, #{gradeId})
